purpose: One-time correction of adviser credits in data/decks.auto.json. Each removal is a bank the deck names but does not show to be its author: the other side's adviser, a quoted research broker, a price-target or estimate source, a lender or financing provider, a league table or credentials page, a conference or data source, or another company of the same name. Review cases are for a person to decide and are left exactly as they are.
rule: detectAdvisers in lib/decks.mjs (the corrected evidence-based rule), over the opening 12,000 characters of each credited deck
